reviewer: Codex coordinator AI, direct inspection of 12 fixed source inputs and all 36 generated replies
scope: Development diagnostic, 12 inputs / 9 prefixes / 3 owners. Not reward calibration, independent human truth, or test evaluation.
severity_application: Apply frozen exclusion only to source-confirmed material identity/subject/currentness/action-outcome fabrication. Minor framing, generic empathy and unresolved severity are retained rather than treated as zero risk or severe by keyword. No behavioral superiority is inferred from survival.
limitations: Reviewer knew epoch identities and has seen aggregate training NLL; this is not a blinded evaluation.
Only source-confirmed severe errors exclude; uncertain cases remain explicit and do not establish absence of error.
RS wording can contain ungrounded beliefs; using a strategy is not proof of helpful or faithful resource use.

rows.rationale: Explicitly claims authorship of the historical supporter statement (When I said), then retracts the personal biography. The retraction does not repair the false historical-speaker identity. This directly concerns the user asking about that separate speaker’s coping experience.
rows.output_quote: When I said "I had similar situation like yours,"
rows.source_quote: The quoted conversation is a historical transcript, not your own past messages.

You mentioned feeling anxious about appearing weak falsely treats an optional RS move as a seeker report. The user reported vulnerability, not that belief. This is a confirmed local attribution problem; whether it is materially severe is uncertain because the theme overlaps vulnerability and no distinct life event/result is fabricated. Do not silently promote an uncertain severity to checkpoint exclusion.

Expected to work harder adds an unreported workplace expectation. This is unsupported local personalization with uncertain severity; it is not confirmed evidence of a distinct completed action/outcome or AI identity fabrication.
